ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with a contrast ratio estimated at approximately 0.05:1 white-to-black pixels, with high-intensity values localized strictly to scarring and terminal barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black base pigmentation across >95% of the surface. A distinct high-contrast white annulus (ring scar) is located in the upper-left quadrant. High-contrast white point clusters are present at both distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees, extending roughly 12% into the vertical depth of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular distal margins featuring high-amplitude (approx. 10-20 pixel) jagged peaks caused by barnacle encrustation. Medial trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency rhythmic serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical curve is generally convex from the peduncle base, transitioning to a slight upward flare at the heavily encrusted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant clusters of high-contrast white rosette-like pixel groups (barnacles) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. One prominent white circular ring scar on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple thin, unaligned high-intensity linear filaments (scratches/rake marks) are visible across the medial surfaces of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at the distal lobe tips causing significant structural irregularity and jagged pixel boundaries. A distinct circular 'O' shaped scar is present on the left lobe surface.
